verdict.rationale: The docs site serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200), and code samples appear on the site and docs, including SDK snippets like `client.source_connections.create`. That is the raw material for an API reference with examples, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive reference or examples you can run in the browser. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable in-page examples, a rendered API reference page, independent hands-on corroboration.
